import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
import time
from email.message import EmailMessage
from urllib.parse import quote

TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 3600


def get_db(path="app.db"):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS password_resets ("
        "token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, "
        "expires_at REAL NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)"
    )
    return conn


def hash_token(token):
    return hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def create_reset_token(conn, user_id, ttl=TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS):
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM password_resets WHERE user_id = ? OR expires_at < ?", (user_id, time.time()))
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO password_resets (token_hash, user_id, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (hash_token(token), user_id, time.time() + ttl),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return token


def send_reset_email(to_addr, token):
    base_url = os.environ.get("APP_BASE_URL", "https://example.com")
    link = f"{base_url}/reset-password?token={quote(token)}"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "Reset your password"
    msg["From"] = os.environ["SMTP_FROM"]
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    msg.set_content(
        f"We received a request to reset your password.\n\n{link}\n\n"
        f"This link expires in {TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS // 60} minutes. "
        "If you did not request it, ignore this email."
    )
    host = os.environ["SMTP_HOST"]
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=10) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        server.send_message(msg)


def request_password_reset(conn, email):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()
    if row is not None:
        token = create_reset_token(conn, row[0])
        send_reset_email(email, token)
    return True


def verify_reset_token(conn, token):
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT token_hash, user_id, expires_at, used FROM password_resets WHERE token_hash = ?",
        (hash_token(token),),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None or row[3] or row[2] < time.time():
        return None
    if not hmac.compare_digest(row[0], hash_token(token)):
        return None
    return row[1]


def consume_reset_token(conn, token):
    user_id = verify_reset_token(conn, token)
    if user_id is None:
        return None
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE password_resets SET used = 1 WHERE token_hash = ? AND used = 0",
        (hash_token(token),),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return user_id if cur.rowcount == 1 else None
